## Why visit

The most useful cask anchor for a Birkenhead visit, with military and shipping objects giving it a distinct local identity. The old pub has been brought back to life as a busy free house, and the mural recalling HMS Birkenhead provides a strong connection to the town. Combine it with the Stork for historic interiors, or Glen Affric for a production taproom, depending on your priorities. It is an easy first stop after crossing the river by train and offers a meal option as well.

## Beer

CAMRA records Brimstage Trapper’s Hat and Ossett White Rat plus changing cask guests.

## Food

CAMRA lists meals, with different Sunday and Monday service patterns; check before planning lunch.

## Plan the visit

The former barber shop closed in 2016; do not expect a haircut-and-pint experience. Multiple sports screens may dominate.

**Getting there:** Very close to Birkenhead Hamilton Square station.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
